name: cardinality-supplying-tier-gates-are-explicit
body: `validate_cardinalities` gates only the two tier-crossing coverage rules whose subject tier is more abstract than their data tier (requirement coverage on Domain in scope, service realisation on Solution in scope); every other rule relies on its subject tier already including its data tier in the cumulative window. Limit: a future rule whose subject tier is more abstract than its data supply must add its own supplying-tier gate, or a scoped run will demand completeness from a tier it is not checking. Upgrade by centralising the gate (a rule-to-supplying-tier table) when a third such rule appears.
